memberdef.name: MemSDNode

briefdescription.para: Returns alignment and volatility of the memory access.
Return the SubclassData value, without HasDebugValue.

detaileddescription.para: This contains an encoding of the volatile flag, as well as bits used by subclasses. This function should only be used to compute a FoldingSetNodeID value. The HasDebugValue bit is masked out because CSE map needs to match nodes with debug info with nodes without debug info. Same is about isDivergent bit.

briefdescription.para: Returns the AA info that describes the dereference.
Returns the Ranges that describes the dereference.
Returns the synchronization scope ID for this memory operation.
Return the atomic ordering requirements for this memory operation.

detaileddescription.para: For cmpxchg atomic operations, return the atomic ordering requirements when store occurs.

briefdescription.para: Return a single atomic ordering that is at least as strong as both the success and failure orderings for an atomic operation.

detaileddescription.para: (For operations other than cmpxchg, this is equivalent to getSuccessOrdering().)

briefdescription.para: Return true if the memory operation ordering is Unordered or higher.
Returns true if the memory operation doesn't imply any ordering constraints on surrounding memory operations beyond the normal memory aliasing rules.
Returns true if the memory operation is neither atomic or volatile.
Return the type of the in-memory value.
Return a MachineMemOperand object describing the memory reference performed by operation.
Return the address space for the associated pointer.
Update this MemSDNode's MachineMemOperand information to reflect the alignment of NewMMO, if it has a greater alignment.

detaileddescription.para: This must only be used when the new alignment applies to all users of this MachineMemOperand.

briefdescription.para: This is an abstract virtual class for memory operations.
